subject: Efficient staff storage
hook: Made-to-measure staff storage for offices, staff rooms and workplaces.
gbp:
Bespoke staff and office storage for local businesses.

When standard office furniture doesn't fit the room, or there simply isn't enough of it, made-to-measure storage can use every wall, alcove and corner properly.

Who it's for: offices, staff rooms, salons, clinics, showrooms and workshops that need somewhere sensible for coats, personal belongings, supplies and paperwork.

What we make:
- Staff lockers and personal storage
- Kitchenette and tea-point cupboards
- Coat and bag storage near entrances
- Tall stationery and supply cupboards with adjustable shelves
- Filing and archive storage, plus reception desks to match

How it works: a free, no-obligation design consultation, a measuring visit and an itemised quote with transparent pricing. Everything is manufactured in our own workshop, quality-checked, then delivered and installed by our own team, with the fit planned to keep disruption to your working day low.

We work with businesses across Stoke-on-Trent and the surrounding area, from single rooms to whole floors. Tap Learn more to see our commercial cabinet making.
